systemctl cat chan-orders-regr 2>/dev/null | grep -i 'Environment\|ExecStart' | cut -c1-300; cd /opt/trading-bot/positions_regr && python3 - <<'PY'
import json, time, collections
os=json.load(open('orders.json')); now=time.time()*1000
rec=[o for o in os if now-o.get('created_t', o.get('t',0)) < 48*3600000] if os and ('created_t' in os[0] or 't' in os[0]) else os[-300:]
print('orders total', len(os), 'keys', sorted(os[-1].keys())[:40])
print('recent', len(rec))
c=collections.Counter((o.get('rule'), o.get('status')) for o in rec); print(c.most_common(14))
ps=json.load(open('positions.json')); cl=[p for p in ps if p.get('status')=='closed']
oid={o['id']:o for o in os}
def stat(rule_pred, name):
    xs=[p for p in cl if rule_pred(oid.get(p.get('order_id'),{}).get('rule',''))]
    if xs: print(name, 'n', len(xs), 'win%% %.0f'%(100*sum(1 for p in xs if p.get('pnl_usd',0)>0)/len(xs)), 'sum r %.1f'%sum(p.get('r_mult',0) for p in xs), 'avg r %.2f'%(sum(p.get('r_mult',0) for p in xs)/len(xs)))
stat(lambda r: r in ('chan_top','chan_bottom'), 'Авто limit у линии')
stat(lambda r: r in ('retest_up','retest_down'), 'Авто ретест')
stat(lambda r: r.startswith('tg_'), 'Монитор/экспресс (tg_*)')
